title: Unveiled: What Tom Brady and the Raiders want to exchange Star Man Maxx Crosby
text:
By Leocciano Callao
Published: 23:48 GMT, February 13, 2025 | Updated: 23:56 GMT, February 13, 2025
With the rebuilding of the Las Vegas Raiders in full swing, the pieces and assets are Tom Brady and Co. can acquire in exchange for Maxx Crosby clear.
The 27-year-old has already been to the franchise for six of his seasons and wanted to be a ‘Raider for life’ in the past.
However, he has also expressed his frustrations about the ever -changing cast and increasing losses of the team.
Given Crosby’s wish to win, a move this season can be a feasible move for him this season.
And with a new era in Sin City, with Tom Brady who influences a lot of the decisions of the front office, the team wants to acquire a franchise quarterback to build around, according to Tom Pelissero and Ian Rapoport .
The Raiders can consider acting their star defense transmission for a premium of picks to speed up the process.
The Raiders will try to get concept activa and a franchise quarterback for Star De Maxx Crosby
Tom Brady has influenced a lot of the decision -making in Vegas since he became a co -owner
Brady’s influence has already been practiced in hiring Pete Carroll as the head coach of Raiders and John Spytek as their GM. The changes came after a 4-13 season for Las Vegas.
The seven-fold super bowl champion, who had approved his minority property at the end of 2024, immediately took the hurdle wheel in Vegas and supplied the rebuilding.
Brady, who officially became a minority owner in October, was strongly involved in interviewing coaching candidates in October. He also hopes that the couple could turn around the fate of the Raiders.
“We want to build something here and again, that has been the process and mentality all the while,” said Davis. ‘Like I said, it was compensated or blown up a bit when Jon Gruden was sent away and so we try to get it right since then and we will see, but I have patience to get it right, and I think we are the people now Having – again, I have always felt that – results are what speak to me and that is what we will see. ‘
With filled leadership positions, the Raiders will start the rebuilding process in the field with Crosby’s future in Las Vegas that remains a question.
Crosby made 28 solo and 17 assisted tackles with 7.5 bags last season. He has two years and about $ 44 million left to the extension he signed in 2022.
